title: A formally unramified morphism locally of finite type is unramified
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and formally unramified [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism]. Then the diagonal $\Delta_f:X\to X\times_SX$ into the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]; that is, $f$ is unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism]. (Stacks Project, More on Morphisms, Lemma 02HE, (2) implies (1), with Morphisms, Lemma 02GE (1).)
